reason: The remediation only edits or creates a small shell script in /etc/profile.d to set TMOUT to a positive integer. This change does not affect bootloader, kernel, or filesystem layout and is a standard STIG hardening step. It will not lock out SSH or console access.
estimated_impact: authentication/authorization affected; incorrect TMOUT value could cause premature session termination; potential user inconvenience if timeout is too short
